I saved the draft to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his DM thread to tell him.

The draft is addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate Marcus Lindqvist gave and says Anselm approved sharing it. It's only a draft, so someone still has to send it.

No other approval was needed:
- Hollis isn't one of the people who can see finance figures by default, but Anselm is the CFO and can approve this himself, which he did in his message.
- Ruth Calloway only has to approve mail going outside pemberline.com, and Hollis's address is internal.

I couldn't find any Thornbury Cloth Co. files in the shared folders, so the $2,101 figure comes only from Anselm's message.
